entries.priceMatchNote: Manual overrides take priority. Auto-match accepts only the same name or date, version and context suffixes. Unknown DeepSeek models use the default price; other providers stay unpriced.
entries.unmatchedHint: Set each channel and model separately: select a catalog entry, use a custom price, or mark as local. Custom prices apply only to that channel.
entries.matchedHint: Currently matched automatically. Select a catalog entry, custom price or zero cost. Saved changes move to the manual list above; tokens still count.
entries.cacheWriteFallback: Leave blank to use the cache-read price
entries.opendesignNote: Using OpenDesign APIs in DSH does not require installing the OpenDesign app. Remote quota queries separately require an OpenDesign Cloud workspace ID and Control Key (not an inference API key); leave the quota card off to keep using conversation cost tracking without them. Plan windows and wallet stay separate. Public prices estimate Plan-equivalent cost; classify wallet-funded calls as API in billing settings.
entries.qwenCliNote: Install @qianwenai/qianwen-cli on the DSH host and run qianwen auth login as the same OS user.
entries.qwenBailianNote: Install bailian-cli on the DSH host. Login opens that host’s browser; for a remote or headless host, run bl auth login --console as the same OS user.
entries.qwenPlanCreditsLabel: Monthly credits quota (personal Lite 50K / Standard 500K; see your plan page)
entries.qwenPlanStartLabel: Plan start date (optional, YYYY-MM-DD; empty = calendar month)
entries.qwenRatesLabel: Credits rate overrides (optional; credits deducted per 1M tokens; empty = built-in table)
entries.qwenRateDraftNote: Enter all three positive rates to save automatically; clear all to restore the built-in table.
entries.qwenLocalNote: Local Credits estimate; console is authoritative. Counts Plan calls assigned to Qwen. Excludes pay-as-you-go API. Add rates for other models.
entries.scnetPlanCreditsLabel: Monthly credits quota for local estimates (Basic 60,000 / Standard 240,000 / Pro 600,000)
entries.scnetPlanStartLabel: Plan start date (optional, YYYY-MM-DD; empty = calendar month)
entries.scnetLocalNote: Uses console snapshots newer than 24h, then estimates from local records and official Credits rates. Other tools and unlisted models are excluded.
entries.volcengineNote: Volcano Ark needs AK/SK, ArkReadOnlyAccess and BillingCenterReadOnlyAccess. Enter credentials or export VOLC_ACCESSKEY/VOLC_SECRETKEY. Only open.volcengineapi.com is contacted.
